title: Exclude every proper-frame recoding of proportional native triples (no new κ)
body:
Resolve the simultaneous-triple question left by #6767. On the exact #6702 word used by #6726, all 14 proportional triples fail every proper subset of their three intermediate frames: 98 topologies. Forty-two exact rational separators exclude even the union of all residence times, arbitrary rational injections and free full-bank cleanup. The common deleted-export target makes the subset argument valid.

python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-triple-carrier-obstruction

Executed: normal/optimized registered replays; exact 631-interval census; separate full forward-SSA reconstruction; 42 scalar adjoints checking 227,055 literal cuts. Fourteen original-chronology controls, 126 witness/inventory/target mutations and 56 scalar controls pass. Source-chain corruption rejects. Committed bytes/modes and final Git-free normal/optimized replays pass; complete remote tree matches tested files.

No new κ. This is a fixed-source, fixed-recipient-history obstruction for the stated original-frame inventories. New frames, interacting sources, changed histories and output contracts remain open. All five framework assumptions remain; no full native admission, selected scientific cold replay, hosted CI or proof-kernel acceptance is claimed.
